fields.name: display_information_2
fields.fieldText:
Add one choice to the box below. Click on the + to add additional items. Total items should be approximately $100.

Do not include a bicycle as part of the $100 for gifts. Do not ask for in-store gift cards.

fields.name: display_info
fields.fieldText: Select a bike ONLY if your child does not have a bike. Choose size carefully, no substitutions.

fields.name: BIKE
fields.helpText:
Bike size guide:

  • Trike = ages 1 1/2 to 3
  • 12" = height of 36 - 42 inches
  • 16" = 42 - 48 inches
  • 20" = 44 to 56 inches
  • 24" = 56 to 68 inches
  • 26" = 60+ inches
